meta.title: Semantic layer: how a Knowledge entry tracks code drift
meta.subtitle: Planned (layer design §4.3): status changes when the anchored code changes; indexing never deletes an entry

cards.title: Anchored by stable ids
items: An entry points at structural nodes through ABOUT / STEP / FROM / TO edges
Ids have no line numbers, so ordinary edits keep the edges attached
Each anchor edge stores anchor_key and anchor_hash; reconcile compares them after every ops index

cards.title: Drift, not deletion
items: Function, Class, Schema anchors compare body_hash; a File compares its content hash
Code moved to another file: re-attached by qualname within the service, marked Stale
Code deleted: Orphaned, anchor_key kept; if the code returns with the same hash it is Current again
revise() writes a new entry that SUPERSEDES the stale one; the new entry starts Current

cards.title: Read paths
items: code_context, trace_flow and service_map return attached entries, with stale ones flagged
recall and search_code search entries by meaning (vector + text)
ops knowledge export writes them to a committed ops-knowledge/ file
retract(id, reason) works from any status (drawn once, from Stale); entries are never hard-deleted
